title: Chapter 21
text: And in the mountains of the Steelridge range, the green dragons of the Uaineloidsig line, known for their keen intellect and rational countenance, offered their ancestral hatching grounds for the good of dragonkind, and the wards of Navarre were woven by the First Six at what is now Basgiath War College. —U NITED N AVARRE, A S TUDY IN S URVIVAL BY G RATO B URNELL , C URATOR OF THE S CRIBE Q UADRANT
